purpose: Remove prompt-to-slot assignment order as the final known concurrency confounder before attributing nondeterminism to base kernels/runtime.
only_change_from_deep_base: The client sleeps index * 10 ms after the common barrier and before issuing each request. For c16 this creates a deterministic 0..150 ms arrival order inside the unchanged 750 ms server admission window.
fixed_configuration: TP1, Q4_K_M, MTP0, FEATURE_PROFILE=base, Q4K_REORDER=0, c16, context 8192, batch 2048, ubatch 256, queue settle 750 ms, launch stagger 10 ms, 128 tokens, zero cache, temperature 0, seed 42.
pilot_gates: One 16-request server cohort; request-start order follows prompt index 0..15; 16/16 complete token-ID outputs; zero cached tokens; zero collisions; WDC absent; kernel and cleanup gates clean.
next_gate: Freeze the ordered deep-base oracle and require a fresh replay with the same indexed arrival order. A 16/16 pass establishes a deterministic floor. A failure is valid evidence of nondeterminism below request admission/order controls.
harness_test: An 8-thread local fake-request unit check observed exact index order 0..7 with a 2 ms stagger.
